card.name: Footnote marks after table titles
card.fires_on: The footnote marker (an asterisk, a lone letter a, or a closing bracket plus asterisk) that ends a table title, just before the column headings begin. It also fires on a similar word ending a caption.

modes.label: Asterisk after title
modes.description: An asterisk attached to the end of a table title, pointing to a note below.
modes.example: Table 1. Dosage Guidelines for Linezolid Infection<<*>> Dosage and Route of Administration Recommended Duration

modes.label: Superscript letter a
modes.description: A lone letter a used as a footnote marker at the end of a table title.
modes.example: Table 3. Established and Other Potentially Significant Drug Interactions<< a>> ↑ = Increase; ↓ = Decrease

modes.label: Closing bracket with asterisk
modes.description: A parenthesis and asterisk closing a regimen note in a table title.
modes.example: Table 5. Otitis Media: (Single-dose Regimen<<)*>> Dosing Calculated on 30

card.plain: It marks the footnote symbol at the end of a table's title, right before the table's column headings.
